text.en:
The musical arrangement and composition of the Philippine National Anthem as set by its
author, Julian Felipe, is adopted.

There is appropriated, out of the unappropriated funds in the National Treasury, the sum of five
thousand pesos for the preparation, printing and free distribution of copies of the Philippine National Anthem
as adjusted to its original authentic outline.
The National Library of the Philippines is entrusted with the accomplishment hereof.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, September 5, 1938.
